Local painters who know Inner West

Reliable painters across Inner West

Mi Painting and Maintenance has painted Sydney homes for more than forty years, and few areas keep us busier than the Inner West. As painters across the Inner West, we work on Victorian terraces, Federation and workers cottages, and warehouse conversions, each with its own age and quirks. Our father and son team has more than 10,000 projects behind it.

Much of the Inner West sits inside heritage conservation areas, where a facade colour scheme has to sit right with the streetscape and sometimes with council. Older homes here often carry many layers of paint built up over decades, some of it likely lead based, so the preparation matters as much as the finish. We take our time on iron lacework, moulded trims and rendered fronts around Balmain, Newtown, Leichhardt and Marrickville.

  • Licensed and insured, NSW Licence 495198C, Dulux Accredited applicators
  • Free on-site quotes across the Inner West with no hidden costs
  • Open seven days including late evenings, 5.0 from 148 Google reviews

What we do

Painting services across Inner West

One trusted team for the whole job, indoors and out. Tap any service for the full details.

Interior Painting Inner West

Inside Inner West terraces we cut in around ornate cornices, ceiling roses and picture rails, protect timber floors, and work neatly through narrow hallways and tight staircases.

Explore interior painting

Exterior Painting Inner West

Exterior work here means rendered facades, terrace parapets and iron lacework, so we prepare flaking and chalked surfaces properly before repainting to hold up against Sydney weather.

Explore exterior painting

Residential Painting Inner West

Most Inner West homes we paint are period terraces, Federation and workers cottages, so we match sheens and heritage colours to suit the house and its street.

Explore residential painting

Commercial & Strata Inner West

Along the Inner West cafe strips and converted warehouses we paint shopfronts, fitouts and common areas, and can work late evenings to stay clear of trading hours.

Explore commercial painting

Plastering & Gyprock Inner West

Old lath and plaster walls in these cottages crack and bow over time, so we patch, skim and repair surfaces before any paint goes on.

Explore plastering

Spray Painting Inner West

For warehouse conversions and larger ceilings we spray for an even finish, masking joinery and floors carefully so overspray never reaches the areas we are protecting.

Explore spray painting

Pressure Cleaning Inner West

Before repainting we pressure wash rendered fronts, brick and paths to strip away grime, moss and chalking that would otherwise stop new paint sticking.

Explore pressure cleaning

Fence Painting Inner West

Inner West blocks sit close together, so we paint and oil timber fences, gates and iron palisades that front the footpath and divide narrow side accesses.

Explore fence painting

Good to know

Inner West painting questions

Which Inner West suburbs do you cover?
We paint right across the Inner West, including Newtown, Marrickville, Balmain, Rozelle, Leichhardt, Petersham, Stanmore and Enmore. We also cover Ashfield, Summer Hill, Dulwich Hill, Haberfield, Five Dock, Drummoyne, Concord and the rest of the Canada Bay area. If your suburb sits nearby and is not listed, give us a call and we will let you know.
Can you paint heritage terraces and older homes?
Yes, period terraces and cottages are a big part of what we do in the Inner West. These homes often carry many layers of paint built up over decades, some of it likely lead based, so we prepare carefully and keep dust and debris contained. We work around ornate cornices, iron lacework and rendered facades so the detail stays sharp.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we hold NSW Licence 495198C and carry insurance, and we are Dulux Accredited painters. That means the work meets professional standards and you are covered while we are on site.
How much will painting cost, and do you quote for free?
Every home is different, so the price depends on the size, condition and preparation involved, which is common with older Inner West houses. We provide free on-site quotes with no hidden costs, so you get a clear figure before any work starts. We can walk through the scope and paint options with you at the same visit.
Can you help with heritage colour schemes or strata properties?
Yes, much of the Inner West sits in heritage conservation areas where facade colours need to suit the streetscape, and we can work to a scheme you or council have set. We also paint strata and shared buildings such as converted warehouses and blocks of units, including common areas. As Dulux Accredited painters we can advise on suitable products and finishes.
How soon can you start?
It depends on the size of the job and how busy we are, but we are open seven days including late evenings, which helps us fit around your schedule. The best next step is a free on-site quote, where we can look at the home and talk through timing. Give us a call on 0423 842 125 and we will sort out a time to visit.
